name: shellcheck
description: Integrates ShellCheck into VS Code, a linter for Shell scripts.
readme:
# ShellCheck

Diagnostics for shell scripts while you type, quick fixes and links to the rule wiki. It runs the `shellcheck` program, or the bundled WebAssembly build with `"shellcheck.runtime": "wasm"` when the program is not installed.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode.

works: Diagnostics with the rule code in Problems and in the editor, while typing
Quick fixes: apply the fix, disable the rule for a line, show the rule wiki
Links to the wiki in shellcheck directives, the native and WebAssembly runtimes
limits: The shell snippets are not offered: Diode has no extension snippets so far
The What's New walkthrough does not open: Diode has no walkthroughs, the toast's button does nothing
shellcheck.markdownDiagnostics shows raw HTML in the hover: leave it off, the plain hover has the same text
